Recipe Generator

A full-stack MERN application built with a team of three — my contribution was on the design and testing side.

My Role: Design & Testing · Team of 3 · 4 Weeks

Recipe recommendations from what's in your kitchen

A full-stack web app that recommends recipes based on ingredients the user has on hand. I worked on the interface flow and on testing the experience the team built.

  • Tested core features — ingredient search, recipe suggestions, and custom recipe management — for usability and functionality

UI/UX Design

PayWise — Fintech Banking App UI

A mobile banking app concept designed in Figma, covering a home dashboard, an AI financial assistant, and transaction history — built out in two color themes.

Home Dashboard

Balance check, quick actions for mobile recharge and Scan & Pay, bill payments, and reward tiles laid out for one-glance scanning.

AI Assistant

A conversational assistant surface for financial guidance, with suggested prompts and a chat-style response flow.

Transaction History

A searchable, categorized monthly history with sender icons and color-coded amounts for quick reading.

Dual Theme System

Every screen designed twice — a dark purple-blue theme and a light blue theme — to show consistent design logic across modes.
